welcome: WELCOME TO UPON MOUNT ZION DELIVERANCE GOSPEL MINISTRY
about:
UMZDGM was founded in 2007 by Reverend Hyacinth following a divine encounter with God through which he received a specific commission to preach the Gospel of Jesus Christ and bring hope, healing, deliverance and restoration to humanity.

The ministry was born out of a divine mandate to proclaim the undiluted Word of God, set the captives free, heal the brokenhearted, restore hope to the discouraged and serve as an instrument of God's restoration in the lives of individuals and families.

Since its establishment, the ministry has remained committed to its God-given assignment, reaching lives through the preaching and teaching of God's Word, prayer, spiritual encouragement and the demonstration of God's love.

2. Our Foundation
Our foundation is built upon the Word of God and the finished work of Jesus Christ.

We believe that the Gospel is more than a message of salvation; it is a message of transformation, freedom, healing, restoration and renewed purpose.

We stand on the conviction that no life is beyond God's restoration and no situation is too difficult for His power.

Through the teaching of Scripture, we seek to raise people who know God, understand His Word, grow in faith and live according to His divine purpose.

3. Our Vision

To see lives, families and destinies transformed through the power of the Gospel of Jesus Christ, bringing people into a deeper relationship with God and establishing them in faith, freedom, righteousness and divine purpose.

4. Our Mission
Our mission is to:
- Preach the undiluted Gospel of Jesus Christ to humanity.
- Set the captives free through the power of God's Word and prayer.
- Bring healing, hope and restoration to broken lives.
- Strengthen marriages and restore broken family relationships.
- Encourage the discouraged and strengthen those who have lost hope.
- Raise people in the knowledge, understanding and application of God's Word.
- Demonstrate the love, compassion and power of God through ministry and service.

5. Our Divine Mandate

At the heart of Upon Mount Zion Deliverance Gospel Ministry is a divine assignment to preach Christ and become a channel of God's restoration in the world.

Our mandate is rooted in the conviction that God's power is able to heal the brokenhearted, deliver the oppressed, restore broken relationships, renew discouraged minds and give people a reason to hope again.

We are committed to carrying this message beyond the walls of the church, reaching individuals and families wherever they may be and pointing them towards the transforming power of Jesus Christ.

6. What We Stand For

The Undiluted Word of God

We uphold the truth of Scripture as the foundation of our faith, teaching and ministry.
Love and Compassion

We are committed to reaching people with the love, mercy and compassion of Christ.

Prayer and Deliverance

We believe in the power of prayer and the freedom that comes through Jesus Christ.
Family and Relationship Restoration

We encourage healthy marriages, restored relationships and stronger families.

Spiritual Growth and Transformation

We raise people to grow in their knowledge of God and fulfil their divine purpose.

7. Our Commitment
Over the years, Upon Mount Zion Deliverance Gospel Ministry  has remained committed to reaching lives, restoring broken relationships, strengthening marriages, encouraging the discouraged and bringing hope to people facing different challenges in life.

Our commitment remains to preach Christ, demonstrate His love, raise people in the knowledge of God's Word and become a channel through which lives, families and destinies are transformed.

8. Our Mandate in One Statement
OUR DIVINE MANDATE
PREACH THE WORD. SET THE CAPTIVES FREE. HEAL THE BROKENHEARTED. RESTORE HOPE. TRANSFORM LIVES.

Through the power of God and the Gospel of Jesus Christ
